rules.description: Ensure no post is marked postable publicly without active operator override.
Ensure no post state transitions to dispatch ready.
Ensure no real platform-ready payloads are compiled or saved.
Enforce strict dry local-only path blocks on all network adapters.
Strict block on external dot-env or key-vault reads for platforms.
Enforce no active scheduler triggers or timers.
Block any automated operator responses or inbox handlers.
Ensure zero active HTTP scraping rules are executed.
Validate that no financial recommendation keywords are in payloads.
Validate that no signal/trading system descriptors are in payloads.
Validate candidate lineage to block fake stats or price estimates.
Validate citation proofs are referenced and kept un-cleared.
Ensure active limitations remain in stub metadata.
Block post promotion while DQR snapshot indicates unresolved details.
Always mark operator signoff requirements as active.
Explicitly register payload hash lock check requirements.
